portion_doctrine: Script-to-posting pipeline + Level progression framework (0-1K, 1K-10K, 10K-100K) + brand vs following distinction + trial reels mastery + repost system architecture + 10-minute daily system (4-phase protocol)
operating_rules: Script batching: weekly to monthly max, never over 1 month
Filming protocol: one bullet-point at a time, editor removes pauses
File organization: batch folder -> per-video subfolder, upload between videos not at end
Caption structure: line 1 = written hook, line 2 = CTA, line 3 = 3-5 hashtags
Level 1 (0-1K): batch content 4-7 per month, post per schedule, expect 50-100 videos to 1K
Level 2 (1K-10K): 70/20/10 rule (70% proven work, 20% double-downs, 10% experiments), study best/worst videos
Level 3 (10K-100K): same 70/20/10 framework applied repetitively until 100K
Personal brand building: mix educational + storytelling + authority content (NOT just trends/aesthetics)
Post frequency: test for 3 months before changing; post more = higher growth generally, but quality drops if you do 2+ per day on small accounts
Trial reels: test daily with varied angles/frameworks/hooks/visuals to reverse-engineer audience patterns
Repost system: take top 5 from last 30 days, post as trial reels no changes; then post top performers from 2-3+ months to main feed
Phase 2 daily action: 1 min max, repost your top 5 from last month to trial reels
Phase 3 daily action: 10 min max, upgrade hooks or redo entire videos from top performers, post to main feed, later to trial reels
Phase 4: use ManyChat automation + trial reels to trigger algorithm (DM freebie offers on comments, conditional messages for non-followers)
Bio requirement: answer 'why should stranger watch more?' in 1-3 lines with human/imperfect element, use Profile Bio Analyzer tool
Content seeding: leave 1-3 strategic comments yourself providing extra context, key takeaway prompt, or new CTA
Hooks complexity now includes: visual element + words + pacing (not just hook lists)
Anti-edit trend: raw authenticity (imperfections like being sick, casual drinking tea) + intentional quality (NOT lazy low-effort)
Storytelling structure: hook + beginning-middle-end + clear character + build curiosity before payoff (reference MrBeast model)
Repostable content types: highly relatable + cause-driven + entertaining/niche funny + shock value/unexpected
named_methods: Templatizing your viral outliers: break top video into 7 components, transfer to new videos with small tweaks
70/20/10 rule: content batching framework for levels 2-3
Trial Reels A/B testing: create multiple versions with small tweaks, run as trial reels, keep best performer
Profile bio fix: use imperfect/unique human element to convert strangers; use Profile Bio Analyzer (free light version)
Repost system: 30-day cycle, take top 5, push to trial reels unchanged
Repurpose system (Phase 3): upgrade hooks or redo entire videos from past 1-6 months
Trial reel ads: call out target audience + their problem + position self as solution + CTA
ManyChat conditions: if follower then message A, if non-follower then cheeky message B asking them to follow first
Carousel repurposing: convert reels to carousels with specific carousel structure (referenced as separate video)

numbers.phase_4_view_multiplier: up to 30x views on trial reels (reposted content third-seventh time)

prompts: Why should a stranger watch more of my content? (5 min bio exercise)
What are my top 5 performing videos from last 30 days?
What are my top 5 worst performing videos?
Which of the 7 components made this video viral?
How can I templatize this outlier with small adjustments?
What elements make this content relatable to my specific audience?
Am I building a following or a personal brand? (critical distinction)
Is my content: educational + storytelling + authority balanced? Or just aesthetic/trends?
What human imperfection or unique element can I add to my bio?
What hook/script upgrade would make this underperformer better?
content_ideas: Educational content: teaching something measurable/actionable to target audience
Storytelling content: vulnerable, raw, real experiences from founder/creator
Authority content: results, wins, losses, customer success proof
Templatized viral variations: hook-only change, format-only change, full video re-shoot with new approach
Trial reel ads: audience call-out + problem statement + solution positioning
Carousel series: convert viral reels into carousel format (specific structure to be learned separately)
Repost content: clean reposts from 30+ days ago with zero changes
Repurposed content: upgraded hook on same video, or full re-shoot with existing idea but better script/framework
skills: scriptwriting: 1-page bullet format, black text=script, red text=shot, green text=editor notes
video filming: mobile + tripod + mic, one bullet point per take, editor cuts pauses
file organization: batch folders, per-video subfolders, upload-as-you-go not batch-end
content batching: weekly-to-monthly rhythm, schedule-determined posting
analytics reading: use Edits app to identify best/worst performers
hook anatomy: visual + text + pacing, understand component variations
templatizing: break viral video into 7 parts, remix parts into new videos
bio copywriting: human element (imperfection/oddity) + reason to follow, no AI tone
trial reels strategy: daily testing with varied angles, reverse-engineer audience preferences
repost system execution: identify top 5, push unchanged to trial reels monthly
repurposing: upgrade hook or re-shoot from top past performers
strategic commenting: seed engagement with context additions, question prompts, new CTAs
manychat automation: set conditions (follower vs non-follower), craft conditional messages
brand vs following: understand the 3-pillar content mix (education + story + authority)
gates: Don't post more than 1x/day if you have <5000 followers (algorithm overwhelm risk)
Don't post trends/aesthetics alone; balance with education/story/authority or you build a following not a brand
Don't use generic hook lists directly; contextualize to your person, social proof, and audience stage
Don't wait for end of filming batch to upload files (organizational pain point)
Don't post anything inauthentic or that you'll regret later
Don't trust hook lists without visual + pacing analysis; hooked words alone don't work
Don't mistake 'raw' with 'lazy'; raw + intentional quality is the goal
Don't assume reposts downrank you (they don't, tested)
contradictions: High posting frequency (10+/week) works for growth overall, BUT quality drops if executed poorly on small accounts (under 5K)
Raw, authentic content is preferred, BUT it must be intentionally produced, not low-effort
Reposts are generally safe and can generate 30x views, BUT don't repost the same trial reel twice (algorithm flags it)
Anti-polish aesthetic is winning, BUT editing/quality is MORE important than ever (intentional authenticity + professional finish)
Hook lists are 'bullshit', BUT hook frameworks (visual+text+pacing) are the #1 lever for growth
Easier to build following with trends, BUT personal brand (education+story+authority mix) = consistent revenue, not viral spikes
weird_gold: Level 1: personal account took 2 weeks, business new account took 3 months (brand new accounts harder to grow)
90-day templatize experiment: 12M views + 83K followers just from remixing 7 components
Alex Hormozi podcast: 6 years, 1-3 episodes/week = 400 episodes before hitting top 10 entrepreneurship (decades not days mindset)
Gym founder example: 6 months daily posting, then videos started taking off, then next videos took off, then 'overnight' he's making $100K/month (the compounding was invisible until it wasn't)
Consistency beats outcome: focus on the ACTIONS (post daily, reach out daily) not the money/metrics; that's the millionaire vs loser divide
ManyChat hack: send cheeky message to non-followers asking them to follow before getting the free offer; measurable follower conversion boost
Repost multiplier: can get 30x views on same reel when reposted months later (especially 7+ times)
Trial reels unspam: Instagram patched the spam hack but legitimate trial reels strategy (rotating best performers) still works
Profile conversion: fixing bio alone can go 3% > 15% (90 > 450 followers from same 3K monthly views); DM conversion cascades from there
Brand discipline: 'overnight success' was 6 years of consistent action independent of outcome (podcaster, gym founder both examples)
